item.text: [{"task_id":"a934301b","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    limit = int(round(params['limit'][0]))","    directions = [(int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))) for pair in params['neighbors']]","    height, width = grid.shape","    result = grid.copy()","    seen = set()","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            if grid[row, col] == background or (row, col) in seen:","                continue","            component = [(row, col)]","            seen.add((row, col))","            position = 0","            while position < len(component):","                r, c = component[position]","                position += 1","                for dr, dc in directions:","                    nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","                    if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width:","                        if grid[nr, nc] != background and (nr, nc) not in seen:","                            seen.add((nr, nc))","                            component.append((nr, nc))","            count = sum(int(grid[r, c] == marker) for r, c in component)","            if count > limit:","                for r, c in component:","                    result[r, c] = background","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"limit":[1],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[0,8],"limit":[1],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Remove each orthogonally connected non-background object containing more than one azure cell; preserve objects containing zero or one azure cell. The tensors encode the background, marker, count limit, and connectivity."}]
